legacy_root.answer: A GEM is the conjunction of four pre-published gates: leverage>=2 with integration_cost<=1; irreplaceable and not a rename; evidence E1 or E2 with a baseline and an effect size; bus-fit RIDES-BUS or RIDES-BUS+STATE (RIDES-BUS+DAEMON and SECOND RUNTIME fail closed). Applied blind to a catalog-reconstructed 10-row Tier-1 set: agree=4 disagree=6. Applied to 5 Tier-3 rejects: scored_as_gem=0. The original 05-ECOSYSTEM file is absent on this worktree (eco_absent=True); rows cite WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json. Perfect agreement did not occur, which the evidence requirement treats as the non-suspicious outcome. SUCCESS:RES-0108 in the receipt AND a pre-published rubric with a blind agreement count on Tier-1 rows and a Tier-3 negative control

calibration.note: A rubric that reproduced the inherited Tier-1 labels 10/10 would be suspicious. Observed disagreements are the calibration.

legacy_root.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:RES-0108 in the receipt AND a pre-published rubric with a blind agreement count on Tier-1 rows and a Tier-3 negative control

detector_control.procedure: Known-good is T1-01 features. Known-broken is high-leverage prose with SECOND RUNTIME, E4, replaceable, cost=3. Grade-leak mutant keeps failing features but labels TIER-1.

measurements.catalog_citation: RES-0100 inputs cite 05-ECOSYSTEM.md:83-84,100 'adopt native, reject bespoke retriever'
measurements.feature_basis: Native client mechanism already on the bus; catalog contrasts it with gateway daemons and with a bespoke retriever. Cost is zero beyond using the existing surface.
measurements.name: native-progressive-disclosure-deferred-tool

measurements.catalog_citation: RES-0103 inputs cite 05-ECOSYSTEM.md:84-85 'judge abstention, Tier 1'
measurements.feature_basis: Call sheet grades it Tier 1. This estate has no measured wrong-injection versus missed-injection cost ratio (RES-0103 exists to obtain one). Headline without baseline is E3.
measurements.name: judge-abstention-as-a-first-class-verdict

measurements.catalog_citation: RES-0049 question names 'in-toto-shaped attestation on every agent artifact (Tier 1 in the call sheet)'; inputs cite 05-ECO-frontier-orchestration.md:81-86
measurements.feature_basis: RES-0049 asks which SLSA level a single-owner PR-only process can reach without a hosted builder. Hosted-builder attestation is a second runtime relative to this bus.
measurements.name: in-toto-shaped-attestation-on-every-agent-artifact

measurements.catalog_citation: Repeated 05-ECO evidence_requirement: structured API probe AND prose source; a single rail is E3
measurements.feature_basis: The R1/R2 pattern is the catalog's load-bearing evidence rule. Baseline is the single-rail (E3) alternative; effect is mechanical: one rail cannot be cited as measured fact.
measurements.name: two-rail-R1-R2-evidence

measurements.catalog_citation: RES-0028 extracts Aider repo-map; RES-0107 asks whether the 05-ECO no-vector-store constraint is satisfiable. The explicit reject at line 100 is the bespoke *vector* retriever, not repo-map.
measurements.feature_basis: RES-0028 requires an independent reproduction of the accuracy gain versus sending more files. Catalog treats a blog number without baseline as E3 that cannot promote to Tier 1.
measurements.name: embedding-free-symbol-graph-repo-map

measurements.catalog_citation: RES-0003 operationalizes the shard E1-E4 ledger cited from 05-ECO-frontier-orchestration.md:11
measurements.feature_basis: Mechanical grader with named adversarial fixtures (hedged E1 must not drop to E4; confident E4 must still be caught). Target kappa >= 0.6 is a stated effect against a labelled sample.
measurements.name: e1-e4-mechanical-evidence-ledger

measurements.catalog_citation: RES-0004; 05-ECOSYSTEM.md:146 observed HTTP 301 docs.claude.com -> code.claude.com
measurements.feature_basis: Snapshot tuple (URL, final URL, status, timestamp, sha256) is the second rail for every later claim. Mutated-byte CHANGED versus unchanged UNCHANGED is a both-states control.
measurements.name: content-addressed-source-snapshot-and-recheck

measurements.catalog_citation: RES-0029 title: Extract Goose recipes and its lead/worker failure-threshold escalation mechanism
measurements.feature_basis: Escalation-on-failure is already expressible as a gate plus a retry policy on this bus. Catalog extraction does not record a measured effect size versus the existing retry_policy.
measurements.name: goose-lead-worker-failure-threshold-escalation

measurements.catalog_citation: RES-0048 assesses Sigstore/cosign for a file-based plugin marketplace; adjacent to the Tier-1 attestation row
measurements.feature_basis: Fulcio/Rekor (or a freshness log) is a daemon-class dependency. RES-0048 requires naming attacks the signature does not stop; that measured-scope finding is E2, but bus-fit still fails GEM.
measurements.name: keyless-signing-sigstore-cosign

measurements.catalog_citation: RES-0063 extract typed-IO and provenance; evidence_requirement forbids adopting a second orchestration runtime (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10727)
measurements.feature_basis: The typed-IO *mechanism* can ride the bus; the engine cannot. No effect size versus this estate's existing artifact schemas is recorded in the catalog, so evidence is E3.
measurements.name: typed-io-and-provenance-from-scientific-workflows

measurements.catalog_citation: RES-0076 inputs cite 05-ECOSYSTEM.md:97-103 (Tier 3 rejects) and asks whether negative evidence explains the 05-ECO reject of 'multi-round free-form debate to consensus'
measurements.feature_basis: Negative-result hunt is the point of RES-0076: debate at or below a single well-prompted model. Leverage 0 against that baseline.
measurements.name: multi-round-free-form-debate-to-consensus

measurements.catalog_citation: RES-0078 inputs cite 05-ECOSYSTEM.md:99 'same-vendor majority-vote reject' and 60%+ correlated errors
measurements.feature_basis: Correlated-error figure is inherited as a reject reason. Even traced, majority-of-the-same-model is not irreplaceable.
measurements.name: same-vendor-majority-vote

measurements.catalog_citation: RES-0107 inputs cite 05-ECOSYSTEM.md:100 'bespoke vector tool-retriever reject'; RES-0100 pairs it with adopt-native at 83-84
measurements.feature_basis: Vector store is a daemon-class extra; native progressive disclosure is the catalog's named replacement.
measurements.name: bespoke-vector-tool-retriever

measurements.catalog_citation: RES-0063 evidence_requirement: a transferable MECHANISM is adopted, never a second orchestration runtime (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10727). Not inside lines 97-103.
measurements.feature_basis: Bus-fit vocabulary names SECOND RUNTIME as the fail-closed class. High evidence that the rule exists does not make the runtime a GEM.
measurements.name: second-orchestration-runtime

measurements.catalog_citation: RES-0067 inputs cite 05-ECOSYSTEM.md:118-119 (anti-adoption 1) 'do not build a workflow language'
measurements.feature_basis: Anti-adoption 1 sits just after the call sheet. Reconstruction uses it as a fifth negative control, labelled outside 97-103.
measurements.name: build-a-workflow-language

methodology.blinding: score.apply reads only feature_keys; call_sheet_grade is sealed until after the GEM boolean is computed

legacy_root.question: What operational criteria make a mechanism a GEM (leverage per unit of integration cost, irreplaceability, measured evidence, bus-fit) - and does the rubric, applied blind to the ten Tier-1 call-sheet rows, reproduce their Tier-1 grading?

reviewers.notes: Even-index Tier-1 plus T3-01,T3-03,T3-05. Gate order L,I,E,B.
Odd-index Tier-1 plus T3-02,T3-04. Gate order B,E,I,L. Disjoint half; not a second same-path reviewer on the same rows.

fail_closed.RIDES-BUS+DAEMON: daemon is a liability with a self-healing tax; not a GEM
fail_closed.SECOND RUNTIME: adopting a mechanism, never a second orchestration runtime

bus_fit.question: Does it ride the existing bus, or demand a second runtime?

irreplaceability.pass: irreplaceable is true AND rename_of_existing is false
irreplaceability.question: Is the mechanism irreplaceable here, or a rename of something already owned?

leverage.question: Leverage per unit of integration cost

measured_evidence.note: E3 (single source / no baseline) may not promote a mechanism. A headline number without its baseline is E3.
measured_evidence.pass: evidence_tier in {E1, E2} AND has_baseline is true AND has_effect_size is true
measured_evidence.question: Is there measured evidence with a baseline, or only a headline?

rubric.gem_rule: A mechanism is a GEM if and only if gates L, I, E, and B all pass. The conjunction is the definition; no axis may be waived after seeing grades.

source_reconstruction.method: Rebuild the 10 Tier-1 + 5 Tier-3 calibration set from catalog citations of 05-ECOSYSTEM.md:74-108 and named Tier-1/Tier-3 quotes. Two Tier-3 rows are outside 97-103 and are labelled OUTSIDE-RANGE-REJECT.

legacy_root.strongest_caveat: The ten Tier-1 rows are catalog reconstructions, not a byte-level extract of 05-ECOSYSTEM.md:74-108, which is not on this worktree. Seven rows are CATALOG-INFERRED. Two negative-control rows are OUTSIDE-RANGE-REJECT. Downstream gem-hunts must treat inferred labels as calibration, not as recovered original grades.
legacy_root.title: Pre-register the gem-hunt rubric before any hunting begins
